The love and appreciation for the celestial realm is reflected in this name, emphasising the inherent wonder and awe for the natural world that Hindu philosophy holds.

The person bearing this name may be considered to be in tune with the divine, seeking to understand the deep mysteries of the cosmos and the spiritual realm. The love for the sky may signify a reverence for the eternal and a deep sense of connection to the divine, fostering a mindful and contemplative outlook on life.
